prior_game_written_input.note: This input is an existing WebMelee export from the accepted Dolphin round trip. The custom-preference GCI was synthesized and re-encoded for this regression; no claim that it was Dolphin-written.

synthetic_custom_fixture.construction: Started from this production player’s Everything unlocked export; copied a source-valid name row and PowerCount/PowerTime from the accepted WebMelee export; changed only the tested item frequency, 8-byte item mask and rumble values; encoded with the project GCI codec. This is synthetic test input, not Dolphin-written evidence.
